blocks.html: The 6,000 sqm, 25-obstacle permanent facility attracted hundreds of participants from all fitness and training backgrounds across all ages on its opening day last November 13, 2022.

Obstacle course racing (OCR) is taking the country by storm and Robinsons Land’s Bridgetowne Destination Estate, together with the Pilipinas Obstacle Sports Federation (POSF), partnered to bring the world’s biggest facility of its kind for the first time in the Philippines.
"The Bridgetowne Obstacle Park is a testament to POSF's mission of bringing OCR everywhere and for everyone's enjoyment," said Atty. Alberto Agra, POSF and OCR Asia Pacific President.
It was a jam-packed opening day that kicked-off with the ceremonial ribbon-cutting of the world record-breaking park led by RLC and POSF officials and national athletes.
